units.source_text: 是年夏天，金阁以不时传来战败悲痛消息的黑暗状态作为诱饵，显得更加生动和辉煌。

en.t: That summer, the Golden Pavilion seemed all the more vivid and brilliant, using as its lure the dark mood brought on by occasional sorrowful news of defeat.

units.source_text: 六月间，美军在塞班岛登陆，盟军联合部队在诺曼底郊外登陆。

en.t: In June, American forces landed on Saipan, and the combined Allied forces landed outside Normandy.

units.source_text: 参观者的人数也明显地减少了，金阁似乎愉悦于这种孤独、这种寂静。

en.t: The number of visitors also clearly declined, and the Golden Pavilion seemed to take pleasure in this solitude, this silence.
